Let me pull your bench history first. I can't see any bench sessions logged yet, and no active program either, so I can't point to your numbers or say where it stalled. If you've been benching somewhere else, tell me roughly what you're hitting now and how long it's been stuck.

In general, stalls usually come from a few things: not enough weekly volume on the lift, grinding every set to failure, or poor recovery. The usual fixes are adding a set or two across the week, working most sets at 1 to 3 reps shy of failure, and using small jumps or a rep-range progression instead of forcing weight. A second bench day with lighter, crisper work, plus triceps and upper-back volume, often moves things too. Setup matters as well: shoulder blades pinned back, feet planted, bar path steady.

If you want it built into your training, I can have the engine write a bench-focused block for you. Want me to do that?
